messages.title: Design temperature required
messages.message: Enter both minimum and maximum design temperatures.

messages.title: Invalid temperature unit
messages.message: Select a supported temperature unit.

messages.title: Equipment tag required
messages.message: Enter a vessel or equipment tag for traceability.

messages.title: Component scope required
messages.message: Select at least one component type.

messages.title: Invalid temperature envelope
messages.message: Minimum design temperature cannot exceed maximum design temperature.

messages.title: Override record incomplete
messages.message: Provide the override reason, comment, responsible person and date.

messages.title: Outside guide range
messages.message: No matching record was found in the source guide. Refer the case for engineering selection.

messages.title: No full-envelope material match
messages.message: No single source material route covers the complete minimum-to-maximum design-temperature range. Do not recommend a material; refer the case to the senior or materials engineer.

messages.title: Guide-based material candidates require review
messages.message: The primary Appendix H guide has no full-envelope route. Candidate materials from the ASTM/ASME cross-reference guide cover the stated temperature range, but require controlled-code, plate-form, allowable-stress and service verification before selection.

messages.title: Source text requires verification
messages.message: The source entry is ambiguous and must be verified before use.

messages.title: Component not specified in source
messages.message: The source guide does not state a value for this component. Do not interpret this as not required.

messages.title: Multiple source-listed options
messages.message: The source provides more than one option for this temperature range. Engineering selection is required.

messages.title: Temperature envelope gives different families
messages.message: Minimum and maximum design temperatures map to different material families or options. Resolve the complete design envelope with materials engineering.

messages.title: Historical guide
messages.message: Verify all material specifications and suitability against the current controlled code edition and project requirements.

messages.title: Sour-service review required
messages.message: Temperature-only selection does not establish suitability for wet H₂S or sour service.

messages.title: Hydrogen-service review required
messages.message: Check hydrogen damage mechanisms, applicable curves and project requirements separately.

messages.title: Chloride-service review required
messages.message: Check chloride-related corrosion and stress-corrosion cracking separately.

messages.title: Caustic-service review required
messages.message: Check caustic cracking and concentration-temperature effects separately.

messages.title: Amine-service review required
messages.message: Check amine corrosion and cracking requirements separately.

messages.title: Ammonia-service review required
messages.message: Check ammonia-specific material and cracking requirements separately.

messages.title: Cyclic-service review required
messages.message: Material selection alone does not address fatigue, cyclic loading or local stress concentration.

messages.title: High-temperature degradation review required
messages.message: Check creep, oxidation, sulfidation and other process-specific mechanisms separately.

messages.title: Cryogenic design review required
messages.message: Check toughness, impact testing, fabrication, welding and thermal contraction separately.

messages.title: Cladding or lining review required
messages.message: Base material, cladding or lining, weld overlay and attachment details require a separate engineered selection.
